ValidationRule.description: Incoming Exchange Finance Cleared can be set to Cleared only when all finance section input fields are populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Incoming_Exchange_Exit_Clearance' && ISCHANGED(Finance_Cleared__c) && ISPICKVAL(Finance_Cleared__c, 'Cleared') && ( ISBLANK(Payment_Date__c) || ISBLANK(Payment_Reference_Number__c) || ISBLANK(Invoice_Date__c) || ISBLANK(Invoice_Number__c) || ISBLANK(Total_Amount__c) || ISPICKVAL(Payment_Status__c, '') || ISBLANK(Finance_Notes__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before setting Finance Cleared to Cleared, complete all Finance section fields: Payment Date, Payment Reference Number, Invoice Date, Invoice Number, Total Amount, Payment Status, and Finance Notes.
